title.narrative: CONTACT - Civil Society for a European Moldova

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to strengthen civil society’s contribution to democratic governance, social cohesion, and Moldova’s European integration process. The initiative will enhance the institutional capacity, sustainability, and influence of CSOs across all regions of Moldova, with a focus on rural, underrepresented, women-led, including those on the left bank of the Nistru/Dniester River. Targeted grants will be complemented by tailored mentoring, learning tools, and access to resources via the NGO.md platform and expanded Help Desk services. A strong monitoring, evaluation, and learning system will guide adaptation and share best practices with the wider sector. Through this multi-level intervention, the project seeks to empower local actors to become key drivers of Moldova’s democratic transformation, ensure inclusive and participatory reforms, and build societal resilience in the face of political, economic, and regional challenges. The primary target groups of the project are Moldovan civil society organizations, particularly those operating in underserved and rural regions, as well as minority-led and women-led organizations. The project adopts a rights-based approach that emphasizes participation, accountability, and non-discrimination. Special attention will be given to the inclusion of marginalised groups, such as ethnic minorities, persons with disabilities, rural youth, and CSOs operating in Transnistria and Gagauzia. The proposed project is built on an in-depth understanding of Moldova’s civic landscape, integrates national strategies and international standards, and applies a Do No Harm approach to mitigate risks and maximize inclusion.
